L2501

(reserved) `fs.read` loads the whole file into memory at once.

What

(reserved) `fs.read` loads the whole file into memory at once.

Why

For large files this can exhaust memory; streaming reads use bounded space.

Fix

use `files.open(path)?` and `loop line in handle.lines() { … }` to stream line-by-line. Not emitted yet.
